title: It’s not the size in the descriptions.
text:
It’s not the size in the descriptions.. Description is incorrect. It’s not 16 inches wide as stated in the description and it’s not 16.5 inches wide as stated in the compare items tool.

ITS 18x13 INCHES. WAY TOO BIG FOR MY TOASTER.

WASTE OF TIME.
